nodes.text: XVIII. If anyone has destroyed someone by his sorcery, let him do penance for three years on bread and water by measure, and for three more years abstain from wine and meat, and then at last, in the seventh year, he is received into communion. But if anyone is a sorcerer for the sake of love and has destroyed no one, let him do penance on bread and water a whole year if a cleric, a layman half [a year], a deacon two [years], a priest three; especially if anyone has by this means cheated a woman of her offspring: for that reason let each one add six forty-day periods besides, lest he be guilty of homicide.
